title: Baby on Blanket, Rural Yard Clothesline - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical black-and-white outdoor snapshot of an infant sitting upright on a small folded striped blanket on the bare ground. The baby wears a light-colored summer romper or overalls and looks directly at the camera with raised hands. In the background, a long clothesline strung between wooden posts features evenly spaced clothespins, set against a flat rural field and a tree under an expansive open sky.
